svg.aria-label: End-to-end architecture of the VS-HGNN research pipeline: data fusion, heterogeneous graph construction, the VS-HGNN model, training and calibration, and the inductive scanner with explainer.
svg.text: VS-HGNN: Cross-Modal Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Multi-Label Smart-Contract Vulnerability Detection
End-to-end research architecture: data fusion (Step 1), heterogeneous graph construction, model, training and calibration (Step 2), inductive auditing (Step 3)
per contract: address, tx count, balance, creation
and last-transaction dates, compiler version, name
idempotent projection onto a common key space
Hash equi-join on π(a) ⇒ supervised core
runtime metadata + tool flags + ground-truth labels
D VS-HGNN model (class VSHGNN, PyTorch Geometric)
two node-type streams; three relation-specific message-passing operators per layer; residual + LayerNorm
dynamic attention αᵤᵥ over k-NN peers
G = (x_dict, edge_index_dict, train / val / test masks)
E Step 2: training, evaluation, calibration, benchmarking
AdamW lr 5×10⁻³, wd 10⁻⁴, cosine LR schedule
model selection on val macro-F1 (best ep. 106)
baselines on the same test contracts (macro-F1):
replaces the generic τ = 0.5 decision rule
F Step 3: inductive scanner and GNN explainer
logits z on train / val / test masks
supervision: ground-truth labels, loss, calibrated thresholds
